node.statement: If T is nonvanishing, def-compressed-corner says that S_T with compressed product has unit u_T=Co_T(T) and is an O(delta+epsilon)-C*-algebra. The defining unit-norm axiom of an eta-C*-algebra is abs(||I||-1)<=eta; unpacking the universal O(delta+epsilon) constant therefore gives universal b<infinity and a universal validity threshold such that abs(||u_T||-1)<=b*(delta+epsilon). This proves item (iii).
